purpose: Teach: フリーズ/プロトタイプ/ゲラ/内野/地場/からくり/ペンネーム/中高生

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、システムフリーズ時の手動対応もされますね
lines.en: The police handle manual overrides when the system freezes, don't you.
lines.style: Conversational affirmation, light and observational. Casual rhythm, as if listing things he's noticed. Warm acknowledgment without interrogation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪手口のプロトタイプ分析もされますね
lines.en: The police also analyze the prototypes of criminal methods, I understand.
lines.style: Continuing the same gentle, interested tone. Slightly approving nod in the voice. Even pace, building a picture of competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料のゲラ校正をされますね
lines.en: The police do galley-proof the investigation materials, right.
lines.style: Still conversational but with quiet attention to detail. Almost admiring the precision. No rush, each phrase distinct and intentional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、内野犯罪、つまり内部不正の捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police also investigate internal corruption—crimes from within the force itself.
lines.style: Tone shifts slightly to something more serious, respectful. Slower, more deliberate. The pause before explaining what 'internal' means shows he's being careful with the subject.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地場の不良グループにも目を配られますね
lines.en: The police keep watch over the local delinquent groups in the area too.
lines.style: Back to warmer, observational rhythm. Acknowledging the groundwork they do. Easy confidence in the voice, no judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人のからくりを暴かれますね
lines.en: The police expose the tricks criminals use, don't they.
lines.style: Direct and admiring. Light emphasis on 'expose'—almost appreciative of the detective work involved. Steady, straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者のペンネーム使用も把握されますね
lines.en: The police keep track of suspects using pen names too, I gather.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. The realization that they monitor even online identities. Slightly slower, registering the cleverness of it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、中高生の防犯講演もされますね
lines.en: The police also give crime prevention lectures at junior and senior high schools.
lines.style: Warmer, lighter note at the end. Closing observation with genuine approval. Slower on 'give lectures'—recognizing the community work. Soft finishing tone.
